content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the mvsas driver calling the non-_gfp version of the libsas event notifiers API, which resulted in invalid GFP_KERNEL memory allocation attempts from interrupt context. This led to potential deadlocks or crashes due to improper memory allocation context, as GFP_KERNEL allocations are not safe to perform in interrupt context. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the appropriate gfp_t flags (GFP_KERNEL or GFP_ATOMIC) are passed to the event notifier functions based on the context from which they are called.
